experiences.title: Interactive Anatomy

capabilities: layers shown or hidden as groups

experiences.title: Ambient Clock
experiences.summary: A calm, readable clock over a slowly moving procedural noise gradient: locale-aware time and date from the system calendar and time zone, 12/24-hour and seconds options, and the spoken time for VoiceOver.

experiences.title: Living Wallpapers
experiences.summary: A creator of procedural backgrounds framed for a chosen iPhone or iPad screen: four curated scenes with colour presets, the device's crop frame and approximate safe areas, and a still exported at the template's exact size, read back to verify its dimensions and sRGB profile.

experiences.title: Digital Zen Garden
experiences.summary: A calm sand garden: rake a softly lit tray of sand with one finger in two rake styles and three sand tones, with a preview of the rake under the finger, undo and redo of every stroke, and patterns that rake rows, circles, waves and spirals for you.
capabilities: Two rakes and three sand tones
A rake preview under the finger

experiences.title: Aurora
experiences.summary: A full-screen ambient sky of procedural aurora ribbons, stars and clouds: three skies, colour, motion and intensity controls, a brightness limit no frame exceeds, gentle changes between skies and controls that hide and return with a tap. Stylized art, not a forecast.
capabilities: Controls that hide and return by tap

experiences.title: Shader Studio
experiences.summary: A small GLSL ES fragment shader studio: start from a template, edit with line numbers, run, and see each error on the line you wrote with what to change, while the last working preview keeps drawing. Projects stay on the device; a too-slow shader is stopped. Offline; GPU code is not a sandbox.
capabilities: Editor with syntax colours and lines
Errors on your line, with what to change
Last working preview kept on failure
Uniform inspector with ranges and reset
Named projects kept on the device

experiences.title: Visual Programming Lab
experiences.summary: A node graph lab: wire Time, Constant, Noise, Gradient, Mix, Blur and Output nodes by matching types; the graph compiles into GPU shader passes shown in a preview. A wrong connection is refused with a reason, and every connection can be made from a list. Offline; nothing is sent.
capabilities: Seven typed nodes on a touch canvas
A list form for every connection

experiences.title: Graphics Benchmark Lab
experiences.summary: Three repeatable GPU workloads (textured quads, an arithmetic stress pass and particles) run through warm-up, measurement and cool-down and report frame-time percentiles with their limits. A GPU time is shown only where the device can measure it. Offline; nothing is sent.
capabilities: No GPU time without a real timer

experiences.title: Effects Composer
experiences.summary: Shader effects in a chain: up to eight of colour grade, blur, distort, vignette and posterize on a picture made in code or a photo you pick, in linear-light colour, with a live preview and undo. Save named looks; export full size as PNG, JPEG or HEIC via the share sheet. Offline; nothing is sent.
capabilities: A chain of five built-in effects
Reorder, switch and tune each effect
Your own picture via the photo picker
Named looks saved on the device
Full-size PNG, JPEG or HEIC export

experiences.title: Aurora Loom
experiences.summary: Weave three luminous ribbons of auroral silk into one harmony: turn each ribbon's wave and phase until it meets the target marker at all four gates for two whole turns, within a move allowance. 100 certified levels with hints, stars, a daily level and practice; undo and redo. Drawn in code; offline.
capabilities: Three ribbons to bring into harmony
Four gates that light up in harmony
Every move can be undone and redone
Hints, stars, daily and practice modes

experiences.title: Lissajous Labyrinth
experiences.summary: Tune two coupled frequencies and two phases so a slowly moving point traces a closed three-dimensional flower that passes every checkpoint in order and touches no obstacle, within an action allowance. 100 certified levels; undo and redo. Drawn in code; offline.
capabilities: Tune two frequencies and two phases
Every change can be undone and redone

experiences.title: Wave Knot Keeper
experiences.summary: Move the control points of a closed glass rope one lattice step at a time, never passing a strand through another outside a gate, until the rope's projected crossings and writhe match the target knot signature, within a move allowance. 100 certified levels; undo and redo. Drawn in code; offline.

experiences.title: Hue Compass
experiences.summary: Turn a spectral compass and probe the coloured fog: each clue tells how many hue bands and how much fog lie between the probe and the hidden target. Deduce it and select its bearing and band before the probes run out. 100 certified levels. Drawn in code; offline.
